description: List what is hot or rising right now, ranked by trend score (0 to 100), across the whole index: editors' picks scored by trend signals take turns with brand-store pieces scored by what agents and shoppers look up and click, at most two per brand. Optionally within one category (fashion, accessories, interior), tier or gender (men and women include unisex pieces). Use it for open questions like 'what's trending in bags' or 'in menswear'; use search when the shopper has a specific need. 'hot' means confirmed by demand data, 'rising' means early momentum not yet confirmed. Returns 5 to 20 items in the same shape as search, plus meta.updated_at. Read-only. Without a key, results are capped at 5 and omit trend data and match reasons; a free key (POST https://vitrine.fashion/v1/keys, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>') unlocks them. Rate limits: 10 calls a minute anonymous, 60 with a key. With a key, each item also carries trend_reason (why it has its trend status), trend_sources (the signals behind it: source, url, signal type, date, contribution; [] when the status comes from curation alone) and trend_review (when the status last changed and whether a human reviewer approved it).

anyOf.description: Optional self-identification. Identified callers help us rank better; keys make it reliable.

session_id.description: Your own opaque id linking calls in one shopping session. Never a user id.

gender.description: Department. 'men' returns men's and unisex pieces, 'women' returns women's and unisex pieces, 'unisex' returns unisex pieces only.

limit.description: 1 to 20. Anonymous callers get at most 5.

why.description: One-line reason it matches. With a key.
